verdict.rationale: Gitea Actions is a documented, GitHub Actions-compatible CI/CD workflow engine. Users define YAML workflows that run unattended on Gitea's action runner, including Kubernetes autoscaling runners, and webhooks/API support custom automated workflows, so background automations are clearly delivered. The evidence describes conventional event-driven pipelines rather than agentic or AI-driven automation, and nothing documents triggers or scheduling in depth. Missing for 10: documented scheduled/cron triggers, AI-agent-style autonomous automations, and independent hands-on corroboration of Gitea Actions running in the background.
